tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde stong zung 'jug mchog gi dkyil 'khor la/ /kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi cha shas rdzogs/ /sku dang ye shes dpag yas 'od dkar 'phro/ /dpal ldan bla ma dges mdzad rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang gi ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs nyid/ /he ru ka dpal rigs lnga'i skur bzhengs pa'i/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i don/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i dgongs don ji bzhin bri/ /de la mi bskyod pa'i phyag mtshan gzhan shes sla la/ mi dmar po ni/ rgyal mong rong sogs na yod pa spre'u chung shos tsam/ rnam pa khye'u lta bu lus la spu cher med cing mjug ma med pa/ de'i sha chu sogs kyis nad la mchog tu phan pa yul skad la mi dmar grags pa de 'dra zhig go /rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma rnams gnag pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na/ bya ka ranta te mdog dkar po/ khrung khrung 'dra ba la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mjug ma nag po ring po yod pa zhig go /ngur pa ni/ bya dkar po ske ring ba skad lug gi skad 'dra ba zhig 'gu log sogs byang brgyud na yod cing / ngur pa zhes yul skad du'ang grags pa de'o/ /lug ni shes par zad/ bye'u tsa ko ra ni/ nyin mo ku mud kha zum pa'i dus su bung ba rnams kyis khang par mthong nas sbrang rtsi bsogs/ mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od kyis kha bye ba na sbrang rtse de bye'u des 'thung bar byed pa zhig ste/ de'ang lus dmar ser/ mgo ljang ba/ gshog pa dang mjug ma gnyis ka nag khra zhig go /bye'u khra ni/ khu byug dbyar stod yul 'dir 'dug dbyar smad yul gzhan du 'gro ba la re zung yul gzhan du 'gro ba la re zung dgun ka lus pa rnams skad dang lus rtsal nyams pa de la bya than nam/

yul kha cig na khug khra'ang zer/ bra ba mang par 'dug nas bra ba gsod mkhan gyi rigs so/ /'ol pa ni shes sla/ nya khra ni chu bya nya gsod mkhan sman pa rnams la so byar grags pa 'di bri bya la sngo nag cig bris 'dug g.yon pa rnams na stobs kyi rgyu ljang / dung skyong dkar/ rigs ldan khra bo/ padma sngo skya/ 'jog po dmar po/ nor rgyas ser po/ mtha' yas sngon po rnams stod mi yi rnams pa sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun yod pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba'o/ /'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ zhal lhag ma bzhi nag pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na/ dom/ bya rgod/ so ni/ thod ru/ ba len ni/ ha lam ma he dang 'dra ba la rwa gnyis ya yo ma song ba gyen du skyes pa/ ba men rgod zer ba de yin/ stag spre'u/ chu srin na kra ni/ yongs grags kyi chu srin sna ring po can de'o/ /lce spyang ni wa skyes yin/ g.yon pa rnams na/ khwa ni khwa ta/ 'ug pa ni yongs grags ltar ro/ /bya dkar ni ske ring ba/ mjug ma thung ba zhig go /ne tso/ seng ge sa ra sa ni ri dwags sngo skya/ mjug ma thung ba/ rwa co med pa zhig bris 'dug 'di skad gnyis shan sbyar na/ bod skad du bzhad ces bris 'dug pas dpyad dgos snyam/ don yod grub pa kye rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma bzhi nag po/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na/ gza' lhag dkar/ phur bu ser/ mjug ring sngo/ sgra gcan sngo nag mig dmar dmar/ pa sangs dkar/ spen pa nag khyab 'jug sngo/ thams cad mi yi lus kyi rnam pa can lag thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /g.yon pa brgyad na/ dbang po dkar po/ drag po sngo/ bdud sdig can dmar po skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ khyab 'jug gi bu mo gshol mda' 'dzin pa ljang gu phyag mtshan med/

lha rgyal ba dam pa dkar/ thag bzang ris ljang / lha ma yin stobs ldan sngo/ thams cad mi yi rnam pa can g.yas rnams mchog sbyin dang / g.yon rnams skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can no/ /rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma bzhi nag phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na/ rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin ma ka ra/ nya ro hi ta kha dog dmar po ro shin tu zhim pa/ rus sbal/ 'og gi klu zhes pa stod mi lus dkar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ ngang skya/ ri bong rnams shes par zad/ g.yon pa rnams na sbal pa thu'u zhes pa gangs sbal te/ sbal pa nag po zhig bris yod/ sprin shugs ni rta ljang gu zhig bris yod/ sbrul ha la ni ha la zhes pa legs sbyar skad sor bzhag ste/ bod skad du dug ces par 'gyur/ des na sbrul nag khra 'khyil pa kha gdang pa lce gnyis bskyod pa bri/ rtsang phag nag po ni/ gtsang rong chung sogs na yod pa'i gtsang phag rgya ra yin/ byi ba/ g.yag gla ba rnams shes sla/ bya bzhad ni/ bya dkar po mgrin pa ring ba/ spyi bo dmar po zhig bris yod/ de ltar rigs lnga ka la/ padma nyi ma bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskums pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i gar stabs kyis rang rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len gsung ngag gi /gdams pa mchog la shes nas dad thob cing / /nyams len gcig chog nyid la rtag rtsen pa/ /shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris/ ༈ /sngags lugs kyi phyi bskyed rim ltar na/ tha ma snang zhen kun btags/ snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dbang / lta ba yongs grub ste 'di nyi zer las zur tsam bstan pa bla ma'i zhal rgyun gsal por gsungs pa yin gsungs/

nang rdzogs rim la sbyar na/ mtshan rtog thams cad kun btags/ lhan skyes ye shes gsal ba'i rang bzhin gzhan dbang / brjod pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs lhan skyes 'dus ma byas yongs grub bo// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
